description: Baseline metric thresholds for the full 221-case eval (propose/confirm booking architecture; typed search_rooms tool, returning 4 rooms by default and up to 15 on request via its limit argument), including the fifteen attribute-search cases case_0207 to case_0221. Set from a single run rather than the three-run average used for the earlier 206-case baseline, so the judge-scored values carry more run-to-run noise than before. strict=true metrics require every individual case score to equal 1.0; strict=false metrics require the mean across cases to be >= min_allowed. Judge and Ragas LLM is gemini-3.5-flash-lite (gemini-2.5-flash was deprecated for this account); booking.llm.reasoning_effort is medium. Ragas context precision uses the hotel-tuned prompt in eval/evaluators/_rag_prompts.py, which scores a chunk as useful when it answers any one clause of a multi-part question, and skips turns whose reference is only the 'nothing matched' sentinel ([ragas].no_match_reference) because a contentless refusal gives the judge nothing to score against. Ragas calls retry transient Gemini errors, and a failed call is never scored as 0.0. booking_expected_search_pass_rate is averaged over the fifteen labeled cases, and every one passed in this run; min_allowed 0.85 allows about two missed cases. This run follows the removal of the router's bulk-data rule: case_0208's follow-up 'Can you list all of them?' now routes to booking, and case_0169's 'for each room, show me the base rate' turn was relabeled from refuse to booking for the same reason.
